name: search-results-header
title: Search results header
description: The top of a shop search results page: the query as the h1, a polite count, a did-you-mean correction, category tabs with counts and related searches.
docs: Pass the query as typed and the total across all categories. The heading repeats what was searched with the number of results (headingAs is h1 by default; use h2 inside a page that has one). When the shop searched for something else, pass correctedQuery: the heading names that, and a line says 'Showing results for shirt. Search instead for shrit.' with two real links. categories are the tabs (id, label, count), the first being the unfiltered All; they are controlled with activeCategory and onCategoryChange, or keep themselves with defaultCategory. related are the chips under them and sort is a slot at the end of that row, for a sort menu; on a phone it gets a row of its own at full width, so give it something that can grow. Related searches and the correction are real links built with searchHref (default ?q=term); pass onSearch(term) to take a plain click yourself while modified clicks still open a new tab. The count is announced politely when it changes: the total, or the count of the chosen category. With total 0 the heading says 'No results for' and the tabs are hidden; render the empty-search state in the results area below. EmptySearch repeats the query in a title of its own, so when it sits under this heading you can keep that title for screen readers only, as the demo does. labels holds every word.
